product_overview: RentifyAI is a comprehensive real estate marketplace application enabling users to buy, sell, and rent properties efficiently through a modern web platform with robust backend APIs and AI-driven features.
core_goals: Provide seamless user authentication and role management for Users, Agents, and Admins.
Enable agents to manage property listings with detailed information and advanced search capabilities.
Enhance user engagement by allowing favorites, inquiries, bookings, and a personalized dashboard experience.
Offer an admin panel for monitoring, managing listings, and overseeing platform statistics with mobile support.
key_features: User Authentication with registration, login, and JWT security supporting multiple roles (Users, Agents, Admins).
Property Management including creation, update, deletion, detailed property info, and AI-driven similar property recommendations.
Advanced Search functionality with filters for city, price range, and rent/sale type.
User Engagement tools such as saving favorites, sending lead inquiries, booking viewings/paying tokens, and a personalized 'My Zillow' dashboard.
Admin Panel providing platform statistics (revenue, active users, properties), listing approval management, and responsive mobile design.
user_flow_summary: Users register/login and access the platform according to their roles.
Agents create and manage property listings including details and images.
Users browse, search, and filter properties, view details, save favorites, and send inquiries or booking requests to agents.
Admins access the admin panel to review stats, and approve or reject property listings, with mobile access capability.
validation_criteria: Authentication endpoints securely manage user data and roles via JWT.
Property APIs support CRUD operations and return accurate, detailed listings.
Search filters return relevant results quickly and accurately.
User engagement features function properly: saving favorites, sending inquiries, and booking processes.
Admin panel displays correct statistics and allows effective management of listings with mobile responsiveness.
